# pdf-tool

> Free, privacy-first PDF tools that run entirely in your browser: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, protect and more. No sign-up, no watermarks, and the in-browser tools never upload your files.

Base URL: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app

## Popular tools
- Merge PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/merge-pdf
- Split PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/split-pdf
- Compress PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/compress-pdf
- PDF to JPG: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/pdf-to-jpg
- Images to PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/jpg-to-pdf
- Edit PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/edit-pdf
- Protect PDF (password): https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/protect-pdf
- Unlock PDF: https://pdf-tool-blue.vercel.app/unlock-pdf
